exposure: Neonates born via cesarean section with breech presentation
Neonates born via cephalic vaginal delivery
Neonates born via vaginal breech delivery
Vaginal breech delivery vs. Cesarean section with breech presentation vs. Cephalic vaginal delivery
cohort: Singleton live births in Finland between 2004 and 2017
finding: While birth injuries were rare in all delivery types, the incidence of severe birth injury was two times higher in vaginal breech delivery compared to cephalic vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: The incidence of severe birth injury was higher in vaginal breech delivery compared to both breech cesarean section and cephalic vaginal delivery.
gest_age: Analyzed as a risk factor for birth injury
birth_weight: Analyzed as a risk factor for birth injury
